name: School Mizugi ~Ryoujoku Suiei Kyoushitsu~
original_name: スクール水着～陵辱水泳教室～
source:
The famous swimming club is in danger of dissolving without the proper result at the next competition. Main character tries to avoid being fired by using less conventional methods to stay on board.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
著名的游泳俱乐部如果在下次比赛中没有取得适当的成绩，就有解散的危险。主角试图通过使用非常规方法留在船上来避免被解雇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
